title: Lazy Agents Answer Against Their Own Beliefs: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Beliefs Teaches Them to Act on What They Believe
abstract: arXiv:2611.32884v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents working on long tasks often commit to an answer before they have enough evidence, a behavior called laziness. In our evaluations, they frequently commit even while their stated belief still names several possible answers. An outcome reward at the end of the episode scores only the final answer, so it cannot teach the agent when to commit, because a lucky guess receives the same reward as an answer backed by evidence. During training, however, the simulator can compute the exact posterior over the answer at every step and tell whether the evidence is already enough. We propose Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Beliefs (RLVB), which rewards the agent for taking further steps while this posterior still allows several answers and for committing once the evidence is sufficient. The reward needs no judge, critic or reward model, and it never reads the belief line the agent writes before each action. We also introduce Pro Worlds,

translated_title: 懒惰的智能体会违背自身信念作答：基于可验证信念的强化学习教会它们按自己的信念行事
translated_abstract: 在长任务中工作的AI智能体常常在尚未获得足够证据时就过早地给出答案，这种行为被称为“懒惰”。在我们的评估中，智能体经常在其所陈述的信念仍然列出多个可能答案的情况下就过早下结论。回合结束时的结果奖励只对最终答案进行评分，因此无法教会智能体何时应该作答，因为靠运气猜对的答案与有证据支撑的答案会获得相同的奖励。然而在训练期间，模拟器可以在每一步计算出关于答案的精确后验概率，并判断证据是否已经充分。我们提出了基于可验证信念的强化学习，该方法在信念后验仍允许多个可能答案时奖励智能体继续采取行动，而在证据充分时奖励智能体给出答案。这种奖励不需要评判器、评论者或奖励模型，也不会读取智能体在每个动作之前写下的信念内容。我们还引入了Pro Worlds，（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了基于可验证信念的强化学习（RLVB），利用模拟器在每一步计算答案的精确后验概率，奖励智能体在证据不足时继续探索、证据充分时才作答，从而教会AI智能体克服懒惰行为、按照自身信念判断何时给出答案。
en_tdlr: Proposes Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Beliefs (RLVB), which leverages the simulator's exact posterior over answers at each step to reward agents for continuing exploration when evidence is insufficient and committing only once it is sufficient, teaching AI agents to overcome laziness and act on their own beliefs about when to answer.
